name: test_pdf_guard_accepts_exact_pdf_signature_eof_size_and_hash
description:
Objective: Pdf guard accepts exact pdf signature eof size and hash.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/application/test_document_guard.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `validate_canonical_pdf` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Pdf guard accepts exact pdf signature eof size and hash.
2. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
